docs.title: Synaptic Delta Sync (SDS)
docs.text: Synaptic-Delta-Sync (SDS) is a high-performance, production-grade infrastructure library designed for atomic, secure, and zero-downtime neural network weight updates.

docs.title: Why use SDS?
docs.text: In modern AI environments, updating models often requires a full restart, leading to service disruption. SDS bridges this gap by enabling hot-swapping of weights directly into live inference engines without stopping the process.
